chapter.title: OF CONTEMPTS OF THE LAWFUL AUTHORITY OF PUBLIC SERVANTS

heading: Refusing oath or affirmation when duly required by public servant to make it.
text: Whoever refuses to bind himself by an oath [5][or affirmation] to state the truth, when required so to bind himself by a public servant legally competent to require that he shall so bind himself, shall be punished with simple imprisonment for a term which may extend to six months, or with fine which may extend to one thousand rupees, or with both.
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Indian Penal Code, 45 of 1860 (Rep., Act 45 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)
